rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a taxi.

example.english: We called a taxi to the airport.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 dik1 si6 heoi3 gei1 coeng4

rows.note: This is a colloquial nickname for a taxi, but 的士 is much more usual.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 lou5 dik1 haang4 dak1 gei2 faai3 wo3
